module: Hardware telemetry utility module (loaded by require): turns the raw information of the audio output device into an anonymized summary. The device name is classified by keywords (virtual, headphones, display, speakers, unknown) then discarded: only the category, the sample rate, the speaker mode and the channel count are kept.
notes: The keywords are searched in lowercase in the name: virtual (virtual, voicemeeter, cable input, sonar, streaming speakers, wave link) takes priority, then headphones (headphone, headset, earphone, earbud, airpods), then display (word 'tv', hdmi, displayport, monitor, NVIDIA/AMD/Intel display audio), then speakers (speaker, soundbar).

fromDeviceInfo.desc: Returns {category, sampleRateHz, speakerMode, channels} from the audio device info; the raw name and the diagnostic fields (provider, driverIndex, useHardware, maxBuffers, caps) are never carried over.

info.desc: Device info: name, sampleRateHz, speakerMode, channels...

returns.desc: Anonymized summary, or nil if info is absent or empty.
